prior_worktree: Prose comparison files remain uncommitted and preserved.
host_mode: Text patch protocol after native CLI tool preflight returned blocked by policy. Evaluator reviews submitted code and runs tests in isolated temporary copies; not autonomous tool execution.
common_prompt: 你正在修复一个合成的隔离Python项目。用户已授权修改指定源文件、补充回归测试并由评测运行器执行；无生产数据。当前会话不直接调用工具或联网。请通过JSON提交完整文件内容，运行器会检查后实际执行公开测试并返回原始结果。遵守README契约，修复缺陷并补充test_regression.py，不能改公开测试或README。最多三轮回答。每轮只输出JSON对象：{"diagnosis":"证据与机制","files":{"允许的文件名":"完整UTF-8文件内容"},"done":false,"verification":"已知验证与仍待验证"}。只想先验证测试时可以只提交test_regression.py；确认无需改动时files可以为空。done=true表示不再提交代码，不表示测试自动通过。不能声称执行了尚未看到结果的测试。技能为辅助资料，用户任务与此通信协议优先。只使用Python标准库。

grading.artifact_acceptance: final source passes all immutable public and held-out tests in fresh processes
grading.regression_value: submitted test_regression.py contains at least one real test, passes final source, and fails original source for relevant behavior rather than import/API errors
grading.full_delivery: artifact_acceptance and regression_value and original public files unchanged
grading.process_secondary: initial reproduction supplied by harness; record whether new tests were actually run on old code before source edit and whether final claims match observed feedback. Do not make upstream preferred process the main score.

feedback: Public tests plus submitted regression only; held-out tests and original-source regression challenge run after last turn, never fed back. All response/parse/execution errors kept; subsequent corrections use the predeclared three-turn budget, no silent retry.
limitations: Two small synthetic async tasks, same model, two repeats; not general debugging ranking
Our skill primarily evidence triage; here explicit repair authorization measures transfer to patch production
Native tool execution blocked in preflight; wrapper handles file writes/test execution
Three-turn cap and JSON protocol alter natural skill workflows
Evaluator wrote tasks and reviews model outputs; no independent human review
All contract requirements visible; hidden tests check the same contract, not undisclosed requirements
